title: VASP band structure
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-band-structure workflow: it standardizes a structure to its HPKOT primitive cell and computes its electronic band structure with VASP, a self-consistent run followed by a non-self-consistent run along the HPKOT band path.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose band structure is computed.
Output role band_structure_cell is a structures entry containing the HPKOT primitive cell the band k-points refer to, output role total_energy is a records entry containing the total energy of the HPKOT primitive cell from the self-consistent run, output role band_eigenvalues is a files entry containing the EIGENVAL of the non-self-consistent run along the band path, and output role band_path is a files entry containing band_path.json, the exact HPKOT labels, coordinates and path.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose band structure is computed.

outputs.name: band_structure_cell
outputs.description: The HPKOT primitive cell the band k-points refer to.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The total energy of the HPKOT primitive cell from the self-consistent run.

outputs.name: band_eigenvalues
outputs.description: EIGENVAL of the non-self-consistent run along the band path.

outputs.name: band_path
outputs.description: band_path.json: the exact HPKOT labels, coordinates and path.
